newsitem.title: UK: European VGO - high sulphur finding homes difficul.
newsitem.headline: European VGO - high sulphur finding homes difficul.

text.p: The European vacuum gas oil market was quiet on Friday in line with a generally slack energy complex.

Activity on low sulphur continues to be focussed on the barge market because cargo volumes were seen hard to source. Prices were pegged notionally higher on account of crude's recent rise from Wednesday.
Traders said it was hard to assess prices because recent trade over the last week or so amounting to upwards of 40,000 tonnes has been done on an Argus-related basis.

High sulphur material was still finding difficulty finding homes with most potential buyers already set up with requirement for November. A couple of 8,000-10,000 tonne parcels were seen available, but finding little interest. Some demand to the U.S was around, but nothing was done on Friday.
